title: Balanced Cell Photo Colorimeter 511
content:
[vc_row el_class="product_feature_row"][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_custom_heading text="Features" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" google_fonts="font_family:Raleway%3A100%2C200%2C300%2Cregular%2C500%2C600%2C700%2C800%2C900|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal" el_class="product_det_feat_heading"][vc_column_text]
  • < 4.0 ml sample volume
  • Highly Accurate & easy to operate
  • Range 0 to 1000 KLETT units
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="2621" img_size="medium" alignment="right" el_class="product_det_feat_img"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]Balanced Cell Photo Colorimeter - 511 measure the absorbance of any solution in the range of 0-1000 KLETT units 3 ½ digit seven segment red LED display. This scale is proportional to the concentration of the solution under test. It is very easy to operate and trouble-free instrument. Concentration of the sample can be directly measured with reference to standard solution. This instrument is ideally suitable for all soil testing lab, fertilizer plants etc.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_custom_heading text="Specifications" font_container="tag:h3|text_align:left" google_fonts="font_family:Raleway%3A100%2C200%2C300%2Cregular%2C500%2C600%2C700%2C800%2C900|font_style:400%20regular%3A400%3Anormal"][vc_column_text]
Scale 0 - 1000 scale (Absorbance Scale)
Display 3 Digit 7-Segment Bright Red LED display
Light Sources 6.3 V, 300 mA.
Potentiometric Accuracy ± 1 F.S.
Test Tube Standard Size (15 x 62 mm)
Sample Quantity Less than 4 ml
Filters Blue (440 nm), Green (540 nm) & Red (660 nm) mounted on a rotating disc
Amplifier Circuit Solid State with ICs
Power 230 V ± 10% AC, 50 Hz
Dimensions (L x B x H) 245 x 300 x 205 mm (Approx.)
Accessories Matched Test Tubes, Operation Manual and Dust Cover
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]
